responsibility: This header declares the Fortran lowering helpers for translating front-end constant values into GCC tree constants and back. It exposes GMP/MPFR conversion routines for INTEGER and REAL constants, builders for NaN, infinity/HUGE, string and character-length constants, initialization of shared constant nodes such as rank constants, and the main entry points used by other trans-* files to turn constant gfc_expr values into backend trees for expressions, initializers, and runtime-call arguments.
same_name_distinction: Declares the constant-translation interface, including GMP/MPFR conversion routines, constant builders, string helpers, and initialization of shared constant nodes. Unlike gcc/fortran/trans-const.cc, it serves as the header contract rather than implementing constant lowering.
